reviews.author: Elaine
reviews.headline: Helpful and friendly people
reviews.text: Excellent- team was punctual, moved items carefully and protected them well. They were friendly and efficient.

reviews.author: Nathanel Femi
reviews.headline: Excellent service
reviews.text: From the booking to the setting of the last piece of furniture, the service was fantastic; the men provided great customer service and were nice, respectful, and professional. I would recommend them.

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.headline: Highly recommended
reviews.text: The move was seamless. Large sofa was tricky but they managed it. They dismantled and reassembled a king size bed. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Matthew
reviews.headline: Great service
reviews.text: Moved everything I a quick, careful and efficient fashion. Great price.

reviews.author: Bri
reviews.headline: London to Yorkshire
reviews.text: They were amazing to work with, both before and during the move. I had a complicated move from a second floor flat to a 3 floor house, neither had a lift. They moved everything! I would highly recommend this company!!!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.headline: Going the extra mile 👏
reviews.text: Efficient from the beginning of the process, Naveeda listened to our concerns as we were two disabled pensioners. Everything was exactly as we agreed truly a stress free experience 👏

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.headline: Amazing
reviews.text: From the first call to Naveeda who was suberb 5 star plus she put me at ease informing me of time of arrival to the exact cost with no hidden extras. The movers were 2 wonderful considerate workers who packed our stuff with care and were polite . Would recommed to others excellent service

reviews.author: Samiha
reviews.headline: Very pleased...will recommend
reviews.text: I had booked them for my removal service. Their communication was spot on and got prompt reply and assurance through out the whole booking process. The kind lady explained everything in detail and gave flexibility for any changes. I had to cancel the booking due to change of circumstances and they promptly refunded my booking cost. Surely would recommend for peace of mind booking👍

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.headline: Very helpful
reviews.text: Very helpful. So careful with the items. Very professional. Thank you.

reviews.author: Jenny Nichols-Dunbar
reviews.headline: First class experience
reviews.text: Excellent experience, efficient and quick really friendly and hardworking. Thoroughly recommend them such nice men, first class.

reviews.author: J Nichols-Dunbar
reviews.headline: Brilliant service from start to finish
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful and excellent service from start to finish from this company. Ali and his assistant Khan were brilliant would definitely recommend them to anyone else who's looking to move.

reviews.author: Brittany Perry
reviews.headline: Accommodating, kind, and helpful!
reviews.text: They were amazing!!! Helped me move out of second floor flat with no lift into a house with a lot of stairs! They were so accommodating, kind, and helpful!

reviews.author: SANDRA WOODARDS
reviews.headline: Care and consideration - amazing
reviews.text: Excellent service by two movers who were polite considerate and nothing was too much trouble. Arrived on time packed and unpacked all my furniture with care and consideration. Would recommend and use them again. Amazing.

reviews.author: Verified Customer
reviews.headline: Careful and efficient move
reviews.text: Stress Free Move Limited lived up to their name. Arrived promptly, protected our carpets and banisters, and got everything safely unloaded into our new home.
